{{{1}}} is not credited within {{{2}}}.<noinclude>

Template to be used as a reference to explicit the absence of crediting information from a media. Not to be used if another reference already establish the uncredited nature of the contribution.

==Parameters==
<nowiki>{{Uncredited|Person|Media}}</nowiki>

==Examples==
Code: <code><nowiki>{{Uncredited|Bryan Hitch|[[War of the Bounty Hunters 4|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 4]]}}</nowiki></code>

Result:
{{Uncredited|Bryan Hitch|[[War of the Bounty Hunters 4|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 4]]}}

[[Category:Utility templates]]</noinclude>
